verdict.rationale: ADK provides local development tooling (adk run, built-in dev/web UI, evaluate module with isolated test-session files) and an offline/disconnected deployment mode, which together allow testing agents locally without hitting a production Cloud deployment. However, there is no explicit sandbox environment or data-isolation guarantee described for production data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, guarantees about production data isolation, and independent corroboration of safe test-vs-prod separation.
